mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_stat_daily_hist (STAT_YMD, BOARD_ID, VISIT_CNT, UNIQUE_VISIT_CNT, POST_CNT, COMMENT_CNT, AVG_STAY_SEC, INDATE) VALUES (#{statYmd}, #{boardId}, #{visitCnt}, #{uniqueVisitCnt}, #{postCnt}, #{commentCnt}, #{avgStaySec}, #{indate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE VISIT_CNT = VALUES(VISIT_CNT), UNIQUE_VISIT_CNT = VALUES(UNIQUE_VISIT_CNT), POST_CNT = VALUES(POST_CNT), COMMENT_CNT = VALUES(COMMENT_CNT), AVG_STAY_SEC = VALUES(AVG_STAY_SEC), INDATE = VALUES(INDATE)
